Teaching

I teach and supervise students in transport economics, public transport, railway systems, optimization, and applied data analysis. My teaching connects analytical methods to real-world decisions in transportation systems.

Examiner and main instructor

TNK127 – Optimization and Statistics in Transportation — Linköping University, Master’s (English) (2023–present)

Introduces linear, nonlinear, and integer optimization together with probability and statistical analysis, applied to transportation problems. Uses data-driven project assignments and modelling exercises.

TNK113 – Transportekonomi — Linköping University, Master’s (Swedish) (2025–present)

Transport economics course covering fundamental economic principles applied to transportation systems and infrastructure investment analysis.

Guest lecturer

TNK125 – Kollektivtrafik och spårbunden trafik — Linköping University, Bachelor’s (Swedish) (2023–present)

Lecturer and co-developer for modules on cost–benefit analysis, ticket systems, and public transport planning.

TNK126 – Trafikens Infrastruktur — Linköping University, Bachelor’s (Swedish) (2023–present)

Lead exercise sessions on cost–benefit analysis applied to transportation infrastructure planning.
